```python
"""An LRU cache with time-based TTL expiration.

Design:
- Doubly-linked list orders items by recency (head = most recently used).
- Hash map: key -> node for O(1) lookup.
- Expired items are lazily removed on access (get/put/size) and during
  eviction. size() is O(n) because it must enumerate nodes to find and
  drop expired ones; get/delete/put are O(1) amortized.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import time
from typing import Any, Optional


class _Node:
    """Internal doubly-linked list node."""

    __slots__ = ("key", "value", "expires_at", "prev", "next")

    def __init__(self, key: str, value: Any, expires_at: float) -> None:
        self.key = key
        self.value = value
        self.expires_at = expires_at
        self.prev: Optional["_Node"] = None
        self.next: Optional["_Node"] = None


class TTLCache:
    """..."""

    def __init__(self, capacity: int, default_ttl: float) -> None:
        """..."""
        if capacity < 1:
            raise ValueError("capacity must be at least 1")
        if default_ttl <= 0:
            raise ValueError("default_ttl must be positive")
        self._capacity = capacity
        self._default_ttl = default_ttl
        self._map: dict[str, _Node] = {}
        self._head = _Node("", None, 0.0)
        self._tail = _Node("", None, 0.0)
        self._head.next = self._tail
        self._tail.prev = self._head
        self._count = 0
```

```python
    def put(self, key: str, value: Any, ttl: Optional[float] = None) -> None:
        """Insert or update key. ttl overrides default_ttl (seconds).

        If at capacity, lazily clear expired items, then evict the least-recently-used
        non-expired item.
        """
        now = time.monotonic()
        effective_ttl = self._default_ttl if ttl is None else ttl
        node = self._map.get(key)
        if node is not None:
            if node.expires_at > now:
                node.value = value
                node.expires_at = now + effective_ttl
                self._move_to_front(node)
                return
            # stale entry — drop it and fall through to fresh insert
            self._remove_node(node)
            del self._map[key]
            self._count -= 1

        if self._count >= self._capacity:
            # Exact live count: drop expired items (this clears everything when all are expired).
            self._purge_expired(now)
            if self._count >= self._capacity:
                lru = self._tail.prev
                assert lru is not None and lru is not self._head
                self._remove_node(lru)
                del self._map[lru.key]
                self._count -= 1

        new_node = _Node(key, value, now + effective_ttl)
        self._insert_front(new_node)
        self._map[key] = new_node
        self._count += 1
```
